measurement_notes.interval_convention: [start_frame, end_frame_exclusive); end is first idle/cut-away frame, not last contact
measurement_notes.precision: Every combat frame in the listed native contact sheets was inspected; overview sheets are 6 fps. Native source is 29.97002997 fps, not exactly 30. Use source frame indices for reproduction.
measurement_notes.hit_definition: First visible target overlap/impact for each proposed coin group. A held starburst and its shrinking/knockback tail are one event. Frame-accurate VFX timing does not reveal hidden engine damage registration. Bounds and confidence distinguish obscured contact from visible contact.
measurement_notes.coin_mapping_limit: No readable skill-name/coin HUD during the attack demonstrations. Names and grouping are inferred from supplied kit, form, count, motif and resets. Procuration has multiple cosmetic rakes per proposed coin; do not schedule extra damage for each rake.
measurement_notes.units: Body height (BH) means upright chibi Don from soles to top of hair in the same shot. Distances are screen-plane estimates, usually +/-0.5 BH, not measured 3D world distances.
measurement_notes.colors: Approximate displayed sRGB palette estimates, not exact source shader colors. Bloom and compression change local pixels.
measurement_notes.range_class_definition: aoe_at_target describes spatial placement of an effect on the distant target; it does not assert multi-target game mechanics. No clearly resolved ballistic projectile or sustained beam was seen.
measurement_notes.workflow: Viewed all 20 overview sheets, then all native combat sheets, then full-resolution details and boundary/contact checks; old notes read only after independent frame inspection. Audio onset file was inspected as secondary context, never used to assign a hit.
